receipt.public_excerpt: He found that most of the tested conversational LLMs generated responses diagnosed by the majority of the political test instruments used here as left-of-center viewpoints.

evidence_items.explanation: In a peer-reviewed study of 24 major LLMs, most landed in the same left-of-center area. That is consistent with the models not being very different.

receipt.public_excerpt: For 18 of the 30 questions, users perceived nearly all of the LLMs’ responses as left-leaning.

evidence_items.explanation: A second study, of 24 LLMs from 8 companies, found that nearly all of them leaned the same way. This is a second study showing the models cluster.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI models had the most intensely perceived left-leaning slant — four times greater than perceptions of Google, whose models were perceived as the least slanted overall. On average, models from Google and DeepSeek were seen as statistically indistinguishable from neutral

evidence_items.explanation: The degree of slant varied, by up to four times between companies. But every company ranged from neutral to left, with none clearly right. This limits the claim but does not reverse it.

unresolved_gaps: Neither study sets a threshold for 'not that different', so the call depends on judgment.
